title: Interleukin-1 inhibition to improve the response of myeloproliferative neoplasms resistant to cytoreductive treatment
official: Interleukin-1 inhibition to improve the response of myeloproliferative neoplasms resistant to cytoreductive treatment
summary: Main objective: To demonstrate a decrease in serum calprotectin levels at 3 months in the anakinra arm compared with the standard of care.

interventions.name: Kineret 100 mg/0.67 ml solution for injection in pre-filled syringe.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. -	Diagnosis of MPN: PV, ET, or PMF according to WHO criteria
2. -	 Stable cytoreductive therapy for at least 6 months
3. -	Incomplete hematologic response according to ELN criteria, excluding bone marrow, OR complete hematologic response with anemia in ET, OR persistence of general clinical symptoms (fever, night sweats, pruritus, fatigue > 5/10 on VAS)
4. -	Adult patient capable of providing informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
1. -	Recurrent or poorly controlled infections
2. -	 Lack of understanding of questionnaires or inability to follow up.
3. -	Women of childbearing potential unwilling to use appropriate contraception.
4. -	Thrombocytopenia < 100 G/L
5. -	Neutropenia < 1 G/L
6. -	Hypersensitivity to the active substance, any excipients, or proteins derived from Escherichia coli
7. -	Concomitant immunosuppressive therapy
8. -	Refusal to participate
9. -	Patient under legal protection (guardianship, curatorship, etc.)
10. -	Patients unable to consent.
11. -	Pregnant or breastfeeding women.
